title: 利益相关者沟通
html:
利益相关者沟通

概述

本章聚焦与利益相关者的沟通，分为汇报与展示、管理期望、跨级沟通、冲突处理四个部分。它提供向上和对外沟通常用的英语词汇，重点是汇报、协调与化解分歧的表达。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合汇报场合和书面往来。建议把汇报类词汇与管理期望、冲突处理术语结合学习，提升复杂沟通中的应变能力。

汇报与展示

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
presentation n. 演示 give a presentation, executive presentation
deck n. 幻灯片 slide deck, pitch deck
executive summary n. 执行摘要 write a summary, concise summary
key takeaway n. 关键要点 highlight takeaways, main takeaway
bottom line n. 底线/结论 the bottom line is, bottom-line impact
elevator pitch n. 电梯演讲 prepare an elevator pitch, 30-second pitch

听说例句

A: Can you prepare a slide deck for the leadership meeting? B: Sure. I'll keep it concise with an executive summary, key takeaways, and a clear bottom line.

A: How would you pitch this feature to the CEO? B: I'd use an elevator pitch: "This feature reduces churn by 15% and pays for itself in one quarter."

写作表达

  • The executive summary distills the project status into three key takeaways for senior leadership.
  • A compelling elevator pitch communicates the value proposition in under 30 seconds.

管理期望

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
expectation n. 期望 set expectations, manage expectations
transparency n. 透明度 full transparency, promote transparency
update n. 更新 regular update, proactive update
risk n. 风险 flag a risk, risk communication
mitigation n. 缓解 risk mitigation, mitigation plan
confidence level n. 信心水平 high confidence, low confidence estimate

听说例句

A: We need to flag a risk to the stakeholders — the timeline might slip. B: Let's be transparent about it. I'll prepare a mitigation plan and set realistic expectations.

A: What's your confidence level on the Q2 delivery date? B: Medium. There are dependencies on the platform team that could cause delays.

写作表达

  • Proactive risk communication with stakeholders builds trust and enables early course correction.
  • Setting realistic expectations through regular updates prevents surprises and maintains stakeholder confidence.

跨级沟通

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
escalation n. 升级 escalate to VP, escalation path
alignment n. 对齐 executive alignment, cross-team alignment
approval n. 审批 get approval, approval process
sponsor n. 发起人 executive sponsor, project sponsor
champion n. 推动者 find a champion, internal champion
influence n./v. 影响力 stakeholder influence, influence decisions

听说例句

A: Do we have executive alignment on the new strategy? B: Not yet. We need the VP's approval. I'm working with the project sponsor to escalate.

A: Who can champion this initiative internally? B: The director of engineering has the influence to push it through. Let's get their support first.

写作表达

  • Securing an executive sponsor early in the project ensures sustained support and faster approval processes.
  • Internal champions play a critical role in influencing cross-team alignment and driving organizational buy-in.

冲突处理

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
disagreement n. 分歧 resolve disagreements, respectful disagreement
compromise n./v. 妥协 reach a compromise, willing to compromise
mediate v. 调解 mediate a conflict, neutral mediator
de-escalate v. 降级缓解 de-escalate tension, de-escalate the situation
common ground n. 共同点 find common ground, build on common ground
resolution n. 解决方案 conflict resolution, reach a resolution

听说例句

A: There's a disagreement between the product and engineering teams on scope. B: Let's find common ground. I'll mediate a discussion to reach a compromise that works for both sides.

A: The conversation is getting heated. B: Let's de-escalate. We all want the same outcome — let's focus on the resolution, not the positions.

写作表达

  • Effective conflict resolution begins with finding common ground and focusing on shared objectives.
  • A neutral mediator can de-escalate tensions and guide disagreements toward a constructive compromise.
